[Issue #2276](https://github.com/jemproject/JEM-Project/issues/2276);Unified attendee status transitions and notifications. [Issue #2275](https://github.com/jemproject/JEM-Project/issues/2275);Unified waiting-list promotion policy and queue fairness. [Issue #2261](https://github.com/jemproject/JEM-Project/issues/2261);Fixed the unintended "Without type" category heading. [Commit 1e82bf8](https://github.com/jemproject/JEM-Project/commit/1e82bf8a2)
update.changes: JEM 5.1.0 beta 1 adds the Point 4 pricing schema, exact tax-calculation foundation and authoritative quote, eligibility and concurrent capacity engine, persistent reservation history and notifications, editable multilingual mail templates, Joomla Scheduled Task reminders, custom-date event series and timezone-aware scheduling. Its compact functional Sample Data demonstrates optional venue profiles and Classic, Single and Multiple admission modes through three university examples, together with compatibility fixes for Joomla 5.4 and Joomla 6.
